page.layout: One column of running text; running head at top with page number at top right; signature and catchword below the last line; footnote (a) at the foot.

main_text.l: Bulla,{a} quam Paulus V. Reginæ Mariæ
precibus largitus fuit, sic exprimitur: Ni-
que fere in Regno Franciæ Hæresium bel-
Religione, tùm etiam in Moribus, non
parum depravata ac corrupta, in primæ-
vum ac pristinum suum statum, devotio-
fuit Oratorii Jesu Christi Domini Nostri
quas in diebus carnis suæ fudit, ut ii, qui
Christum pro nobis in Oratione positum
enus ex Bulla Pauli V. & hæc fere ad verbum

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Words "fuit" and "fudit" are printed with a long-s/f-like letter; read as Latin f-forms, but the glyph is ambiguous. "ij" in the printed text is read as "ii" (vowel i). Some letters in "Hæresium" and "pristinum" are worn. Marginal remnants and scan edges are not printed text and are omitted.
